## Summary

Adds renderer-owned temporal scene-color ping-pong history, deterministic Halton jitter metadata, previous-camera continuity tracking, explicit temporal reset semantics, and an exact fullscreen copy back into the existing caller-owned render target. Keeps projection unjittered and defers TAA/motion vectors while preserving caller texture usage contracts.

Adds ADR 0130 for the temporal history boundary and records the confirmed INC-002 recurrence encountered while transporting this change.
